bull.point: ₹1,78,650 crore was the FY26 revenue from operations, up 9.6% on the year before as profit for the year reached ₹29,474 crore.
₹57,003 crore in dividends and buybacks was distributed over FY25-26, representing 88.1% of total free cash flow of ₹64,716 crore.
₹33,986 crore of FY26 operating cash flow represented 115.3% of the profit for the year.

bear.point: ₹31,259 crore of free cash flow in FY26 was lower than ₹33,457 crore in FY25.
95.2% of turnover came from Software and IT consulting, a segment facing pressure as AI transformation shifts discretionary spending dynamics.
97.4% of turnover came from exports, while management reported that policy changes and geopolitical uncertainties weighed on the tech services industry.
